info.name: Excledge EBM/VSDC Test Suite — ALL endpoints
info.description:
Complete hands-on suite for every CIS ↔ RRA/EBM endpoint.

**Setup**
1. Import this collection + `EBM-Environment.json`
2. Set `loginEmail`, `loginPassword`, `productId`, `branchId`, `itemCd`, `itemClsCd`
3. Run `00 — Auth → Login`
4. Walk folders 01→10 (CIS). Use 11 only for raw VSDC debugging.

**Also available**
- `Excledge-RRA-API-Collection.json` — same RRA surface (partner/demo)
- `Excledge-API-Collection.json` — full backend (~306 routes)
- Swagger: `http://localhost:4500/api/docs/rra` and `/api/docs/full`
